faceDown.title: 👁️ Face Down Detection Threshold
faceDown.description: Lower values detect more sensitively. Consider setting mild/minimal higher when focusing on work.

headForward.title: 🧠 Head Forward Detection Threshold
headForward.description: Detects 3D head position changes. Adjust based on your distance from the monitor.

backCurvature.title: 🏃 Back Curvature Detection Threshold
backCurvature.description: Detects back curvature from shoulder and hip angles. Adjust based on your chair's backrest angle.

alerts.title: 🔔 Alert Settings
alerts.notificationDelayDesc: Time to Notification: How long bad posture persists before notification
alerts.notificationIntervalDesc: Notification Interval: How long to wait between notifications
alerts.visualAlertDelayDesc: Display Time: How long to show severe warnings
alerts.description: Adjust based on your work concentration. Increase interval if frequent notifications are distracting.

tips.title: 💡 Adjustment Tips
tips.tip1: First set your baseline posture correctly, then adjust thresholds
tips.tip2: Start with default values. If detection is too sensitive, increase values
tips.tip3: If detection is too weak, decrease values
tips.tip4: Optimal values vary by work environment (chair height, monitor position)
tips.tip5: Use 'Reset to Defaults' button to restore initial values

mild.title: Mild Slouching
mild.message: Signs of slouching detected. Please correct your posture early.

improvementTips.title: Improvement Tips
improvementTips.tip1: Sit with your back straight against the chair
improvementTips.tip2: Keep your shoulders relaxed and level
improvementTips.tip3: Position your monitor at eye level
improvementTips.tip5: Keep your feet flat on the floor
improvementTips.tip6: Maintain proper distance from the screen
improvementTips.tip7: 📱 Raise the screen to eye level
improvementTips.tip8: 👀 Look straight ahead, avoid looking down
improvementTips.tip10: Adjust desk height and chair position
improvementTips.tip11: Stand up and stretch lightly every 30 minutes
